name: discord-mcp-server
description: A read-only-by-default Discord MCP server with optional write tools and private local analytics.
long_description: Discord MCP Server connects Claude Desktop to a Discord bot for private local analytics and optional Discord management. Read-only mode is enabled by default: Discord mutation tools are hidden and blocked. When a user explicitly disables read-only mode, implemented message, channel, member, role, moderation, webhook, invite, forum, event, and DM tools become available, subject to the bot's Discord permissions and configured guild allow-list. Local analytics writes remain separate from Discord writes. Message content output is disabled by default. The server calls no external AI provider; the connected client performs any interpretation.

read_only_mode.title: Read-only mode
read_only_mode.description: When enabled, Discord write and destructive tools are hidden and blocked. Disable this only when you want Claude to send messages or make changes in Discord.

discord_token.title: Discord bot token
discord_token.description: The bot token from your Discord Developer Portal application. Kept private; never shown or logged.

guild_id.title: Discord server (guild) ID
guild_id.description: The numeric ID of the Discord server to analyse (right-click the server icon with Developer Mode on, then 'Copy Server ID'). Used as both the allowed guild and the analytics guild.

data_directory.title: Local data directory
data_directory.description: A folder OUTSIDE this extension where the local SQLite database, process lock, backups, and exports are stored. Choose a private location; a per-user default is suggested.

primary_user_id.title: Primary user ID (optional)
primary_user_id.description: Optional Discord user ID of a primary user (e.g. community owner or administrator) whose activity appears in the weekly report. Leave blank if unused.

staff_user_ids.title: Staff user IDs (optional)
staff_user_ids.description: Optional Discord user IDs treated as staff, entered as a comma-separated list (each ID is a long number). Leave blank if unused.

resource_channel_ids.title: Resource channel IDs (optional)
resource_channel_ids.description: Optional comma-separated channel IDs where trainings/resources are expected, for cadence checks. Leave blank if unused.

office_hour_channel_ids.title: Office-hour voice channel IDs (optional)
office_hour_channel_ids.description: Optional comma-separated voice channel IDs used for office-hour attendance. Leave blank if unused.

history_start_date.title: Default history start date (optional)
history_start_date.description: Optional default lower bound for history imports, in YYYY-MM-DD form (e.g. 2026-01-01). Leave blank to specify the date per sync.

analytics_timezone.title: Analytics time zone (optional)
analytics_timezone.description: IANA time zone for daily/weekly grouping, e.g. UTC or America/New_York.

store_message_content.title: Store readable message content locally
store_message_content.description: When on, readable message text is stored in the local database (needed for topic and question analysis). It stays on your machine. When off, only metadata and one-way hashes are kept.

allow_content_output.title: Allow message excerpts to be returned
allow_content_output.description: When off (recommended), tools return counts, IDs, and lexical labels but never readable message excerpts. Turn on only if you accept sending redacted excerpts to the connected client.

collect_voice.title: Collect voice attendance while running
collect_voice.description: When on, voice-channel joins/leaves are recorded while the extension is running. Historical voice attendance cannot be reconstructed.

collect_bot_dms.title: Store DMs sent directly to the bot
collect_bot_dms.description: When on, direct messages users send to the bot are stored. These are never other people's private conversations. Off by default.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: Verbosity for logs: error, warning, info, or debug.
